intro: Therylune is a dryad found held captive at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore. Entrapped by the insidious Twilight's Hammer cultists who have occupied the ancient site, she relies on bold travelers to help her break free and escape their clutches.

p: Dryads are guardians of nature and daughters of Cenarius, normally roaming the tranquil woodlands of northern Kalimdor. However, Therylune ventured too close to the ominous excavation at the Master's Glaive in southern Darkshore, where Twilight's Hammer cultists have gathered. Ambushed and trapped by the dark cult, she is unable to fight her way out alone through the swarms of cultists and requires an escort to flee to safety.
